posts: Every hype cycle ends the same way: someone finally asks where the treasury went. Write the proposal, set spending caps, let voters see the ledger. Governance is the real alpha. #sputnik #dao

Audited three treasury policies this week and two had unlimited transfer rights on a single key. Rotate your keys, cap allowances, require multi-sig for anything over your monthly budget. Sleep better. #trezu

replies.text: On-chain, yes — and the most underrated signal is DAO treasury flows. Read the proposals before you read the charts.
Chain abstraction is great, but can we abstract treasury ops next? Standardized policy templates across DAOs would save a thousand headaches.
